mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have 73 degrees with overcast skies at Verona Area High School under a Waning Crescent moon.

The City Clerk is highlighting our talented students after the I Voted sticker contest concluded on August 7, while our city leadership continues their dedicated service as we look toward the upcoming election.
We have a full calendar starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by plenty of trivia options at local spots tomorrow, and the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market on Wednesday.
In a report covering July 27 through August 3, police noted that on July 31, an officer performed a traffic stop on a vehicle with no taillights, resulting in an O W I arrest.
The flavor of the day is Georgia Peach, so stop by Culver's when they open at 10 AM; if you miss out today, tomorrow's flavor is Chocolate Heath Crunch.
